items.what: Release v2.6.0 (Nov 27, 2026) fixes 8 vulnerabilities in the Git, Memory and Fetch servers. The Git server now refuses a --repository root whose .git file names another Git directory, and git_merge refuses merges that would overwrite ignored files.
items.test: Upgrade mcp-server-git and mcp-server-fetch to 2026.11.27 and server-memory to 2.2.2 (on Windows, also server-filesystem to 2.4.1). npm won't offer 2.2.2 over a date-versioned server-memory, so install @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory@2.2.2 explicitly.

items.what: v1.0.117 (Nov 27, 2026): approving an MCP server's tools no longer also approves built-in requests (shell commands, memory stores) when the server's name matches a built-in permission type, and autopilot now asks before launching each extension.
items.test: Expect new prompts for shell commands in sessions that relied on an MCP approval, and for extensions in autopilot runs. Behind a TLS-intercepting proxy, set sandbox.userPolicy.network.extraCaCertificates so sandboxed commands trust your CA.

items.what: Release v7.8.40 (Nov 27, 2026): in VS Code, auto-approve is now a user-level setting only, and a shell command that prints an environment file now asks first. In the CLI, the explore subagent asks before reading secret environment files.
items.test: If a project relied on a workspace-level auto-approve setting, set it again in your user settings. Expect new approval prompts in runs that read or print .env files.
